market_summary: Major pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAUUSD) are strongly extended to the downside below their respective Value Areas and ATR lower bands during New York session, exhibiting signs of exhaustion/absorption near key session lows. US100 and BTCUSD remain structurally bullish above VWAP and VAH but are testing major session highs with signs of stretched volatility near upper ATR bands. All symbols are currently ill-positioned for clean risk-defined momentum scalp entries without a micro-pullback.

signals.rationale: 1) Price is below VAL (4033.66) and far below POC (4043.60). 2) CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.52) with negative slope (-0.42). 3) Active NEW_YORK_SESSION. 4) Price traded sharply below VWAP (4040.75) and EMA50 (4037.67). 5) Price extended past the lower ATR band (4011.62). 6) Recent sharp down move accompanied by RVOL spikes. 7) Session Low broken, but price is severely overextended into the lower ATR band, raising risk of mean-reversion pullbacks. Recommendation is HOLD.
signals.level_event: sweep and acceptance below Session Low

Recommendation is HOLD.
